entries.title: Exact kNN MMA query block geometry
production_callers: NearestNeighbors / KNeighborsClassifier / KNeighborsRegressor and classical exact-neighbor consumers
entries.mechanism: MQ_SG changes 8 to 4; complete 32-lane groups halve per-block query ownership while retaining matrix tile, all index slices and top-k state. Launch and query-grid geometry share MQ_TPB/MQ_SG.
quality_scope: Tie-aware exact recall and distance error
No duplicate or missing neighbor IDs
limitations: Existing eligible feature and k register limits remain unchanged.
Smaller query blocks can increase staged operand traffic; no gain claimed.
Downstream consumer quality is pending, including nonfinite/duplicate/tied inputs.

entries.title: Scalar streaming top-k candidate chunk
production_callers: NearestNeighbors / KNeighborsClassifier / KNeighborsRegressor on the scalar fused route
entries.mechanism: FKT_T changes 64 to 128 candidate rows per shared tile, amortizing staging barriers at a 16 KiB feature tile plus norms for the widest existing admitted row. Every candidate is still inserted into the per-slice top-k and all slices merge.
quality_scope: Exact recall and downstream classification/regression quality
limitations: The existing MMA path must be disabled in BOTH arms or preempts this route.
This changes staged candidate chunking, not merge fan-in or slice count.
The route retains existing feature/k limits and is not the default MMA-route comparison.

Quantization overflow policy and downstream consumers
limitations: Requires the existing blocked accumulator opt-in in BOTH arms on Apple.

entries.title: KDE stable score query work grouping
production_callers: KernelDensity score_samples and score, including resident scoring callers
entries.mechanism: KDE2_QM changes 4 to 2 queries per thread. The query tile changes 64 to 32 rows; per-thread distance accumulators and shared query/reduction pages shrink. The existing query-grid-based chunk planner follows the new tile, retains every train contribution and uses the same stable max-rescaled logsumexp.
quality_scope: Sample weights, support boundaries, extreme bandwidths and far queries
Constant/duplicate inputs and ragged query/train/feature tails
limitations: Only the existing Apple FAST dimension-tiled scoring route is affected; legacy/fallback paths remain.
Fewer queries reuse each training tile, so lower resource pressure can be outweighed by additional training reads.
The chunk planner can change reduction association; FAST bits may move and task quality remains pending.
Keep optional KDE2 sibling flags equal in both arms; the new define does not enable any sibling mechanism.

entries.title: Agglomerative and shared MST reference tile grouping
production_callers: AgglomerativeClustering supported single-linkage Euclidean pairwise route
HDBSCAN mutual-reachability callers using MmaBoruvka, including optional device-round route when enabled equally in both arms
entries.mechanism: MB_T changes 128 to 64 reference rows per shared/prefetched tile, retaining complete 32-row MMA admission groups. quality_scope: Ties, duplicate/degenerate points and disconnected inputs
limitations: Only the existing eligible MMA Boruvka path changes; wider features, unsafe centered norms and other existing fallbacks retain their current schedule.
